episodes.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy: Episode 1
episodes.summary: San Woong and the Saram propose an alliance with the blue-eyed Neanthal, but when things don't go as expected, Tagon takes command of the Great Hunt.

episodes.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The villagers cast suspicion on Eunseom upon learning that he has dreams. Tanya questions her destiny. Tagon greets his men in an unlikely place.

episodes.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Upon finding Do Ti, Eunseom devises a plan to rescue the Wahan and is dismayed to learn the significance of Igutu -- and what this means for him.

episodes.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Eunseom and Do Ti run into a familiar face in Arthdal and make an alarming discovery. San Woong grows suspicious of his son. Tanya stands up for her tribe.

episodes.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Tagon's declaration ripples through Arthdal, Eunseom contemplates the significance of what he saw. Moo Baek seeks advice and is given a quest.

episodes.title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Taealha counsels Tagon about the impending meeting with Eunseom. Mi hol tries to persuade Asa Ron to expose the truth. Tanya sees a mystifying vision.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land: Episode 7
episodes.summary: After a chance encounter, Tanya starts to grasp the meaning of the dream. Tagon's plan upsets Taealha. Moo Baek learns something astounding about Eunseom.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Saya has chilling words for Taealha. Tagon strengthens his grip over Arthdal. Tanya receives news of Eunseom and wonders what Saya's dreams might mean.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Tanya proposes an alliance with saya that proves to be useful for them both, Eun Sum refuses to deny who he is, and ominous signs appear in Arthdal.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Tagon visits Tanya and asks about the Wahan. After hearing about Tanya's dreams, Saya decides to tell her his story. Moo Baek comes across something odd.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Ha Rim makes a startling confession to Moo Baek. Chae Eun goes to see Tanya and tells her the truth about Eunseom. Mi Hol offers Taealha a way out.

episodes.title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Tagon becomes enraged when he discovers Mi Hol is behind Tanya's abduction, and the two later meet to discuss her fate. Eunseom orchestrates an escape.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Prelude To All Legends: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Tanya becomes overwhelmed by Arthdal's reception of her new role, and demands that Taealha and Tagon keep their end of the bargain.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Prelude To All Legends: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Mi Hol informs Tagon about the finer points of being a king. Saya's appearance bewilders the Wahan. Eunseom receives help from the Neanthal.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Prelude To All Legends: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Surviving in Arthdal means knowing how to choose the side that holds power. Taealha is attacked, and Tagon silences those who've uncovered his secret.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Prelude To All Legends: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Tanya tries to uphold the ways of the Wahan but is dismayed to find that they have changed. Tagon's guards make a gruesome discovery.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Prelude To All Legends: Episode 17
episodes.summary: Eunseom wrestles with a proposition and ponders how he'll find Tanya. Saya plots a strategy for Tagon to be king. Mi Hol gives Taealha a stern warning.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Prelude To All Legends: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Tanya receives word of the Wahan and meets someone who's seen Eunseom. Saya grows ncreasingly leery of those around him. Tagon gets what he wants.

episodes.title: The Weak Ones
episodes.summary: Eight years has passed since Tagon took the throne as the second coming of Aramun. Eunseom succeeded in uniting the Ago clans as the second coming of Inaishingi and he leads them to the great war against Arthdal. Meanwhile, Saya must prove his worth to succeed Tagon.

episodes.title: War of Twins
episodes.summary: The first battle between Arthdal, led by Saya, and the united Ago forces, led by Eunseom, takes place in Hanchoa. Eunseom and the Ago forces gets overwhelmed by Arthdal's military power. Meanwhile, Tagon realizes the elevated status of Tanya as the second coming of Asa Sin and begins to feel threatened by her absolute power.

episodes.title: Wahan's Lover
episodes.summary: Arthdal gets shocked at the unexpected situation in the first battle with the Ago Union.

episodes.title: Purple Blood
episodes.summary: Prince Arok, the son of Tagon and Taealha, is abducted, and the Arthdal Palace is in an uproar.

episodes.title: The Sword of Aramun
episodes.summary: The last prophecy by Aramun is announced. Eunseom, Tanya, and Saya try to figure out what it means!

episodes.title: Fake Inaishingi
episodes.summary: Saya tries to take over the Ago Union. With Tagon's orders, Arthdal faces a new crisis.

episodes.title: Ikomahis
episodes.summary: Eun Seom finds an unexpected breakthrough in despair. Saya's plan envelops Arthdal in fear.

episodes.title: The Strongest Creature in the World
episodes.summary: They need to stop Tagon. A brutal night falls on Arthdal. Eun Seom advances close to Arthdal.

episodes.title: Remember My Face
episodes.summary: The day of Tagon and Eun Seom's battle comes. Tagon faces a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Whirlwind Fire
episodes.summary: Eun Seom's Ago Union and Tagon's Arthdal have the final battle in the Arth Forest.

episodes.title: Heroines
episodes.summary: Tan Ya who wants to change Arthdal's owner and Tae Al Ha who wants to protect Arthdal fight.

episodes.title: Arthdal Chronicles
episodes.summary: The final battle between the Ago Union and Arthdal has come. Ta Gon prepares for a personal war. Tanya, Tae Al Ha, Sa Ya, and Eun Seom make one final move to protect what's most precious to them. Who will take over Arthdal?
